text:
deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT: synthetic probes failing for release 2026-03-22-rc3 in us-east-1. 5/10 probes failed (502 / timeout). Pausing traffic shift recommendation from deploy-bot. dashboard: https://internal.monitoring/redwood/slo/embeds-us-east :warning:

maya: @tom can you eyeball p95 and circuit logs?

tom: looking now. p95 for /embeds route jumped ~120ms -> ~600ms at 16:03. error budget for emb-route is 0.8%, current 15m window shows 0.95% (above). seeing a handful of 502s with trace hints to kvcache misses.

ryan: I see a kvcache GC spike around 16:02 in the runtime metrics. rc3 introduced a prefetch change; could be causing increased miss churn.

olivia: can we pin routing back to previous build (2026-03-15-stable) while we triage? release owner oncall approved.

maya: my recommendation: safe-hold + pin traffic to stable, run synthetic smoke, then decide rollback vs config tweak. anyone object? :eyes: 

lisa: no objections from release notes side. I'll mark the release paused and add a quick blurb.

tom: executing pause now. command: `/deploy pause --release 2026-03-22-rc3 --reason "synthetic probe failures"`

deploy-bot: ACTION: hold applied. Traffic shift stopped. Pinning routing to 2026-03-15-stable. Notifying release owners and watchers.

ryan: while pinned, propose temporary config change to reduce kvcache churn: set prefetch=false and increase batch_timeout_ms to 200 on embeds service. Quick patch: `configs/embeds/prod.json` diff: "prefetch": false, "batch_timeout_ms": 200

maya: can someone run a lateral synthetic run to confirm? quick curl loop to probe: 
```
for i in {1..20}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}
" https://api.redwood/embeds/us-east/probe; done
```

olivia: starting smoke run now, will paste results in a min. cc @release-owner

lisa: release notes updated: https://internal/releases/2026-03-22-rc3 - status=PAUSED, note="Investigating synthetic failures; kvcache miss spike observed"

tom: opened incident ticket RED-INC-20260322-1 and tagged eng-sre for deeper root cause if kvcache GC repeats.

ryan: if config tweak doesn't stabilize, next step is full rollback + redeploy with kvcache tuning baked in. rollback command if needed: `/deploy rollback --to 2026-03-15-stable --force`

maya: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring the SLO dashboard p95 / 5xx and ping here every 1m. please post smoke results and any trace snippets. :thumbsup:
